blurb: Guests can visit the Beer Garden and Restaurant for a variety of beers including seasonal and small batch series, paired with a menu of shareables, salads, sandwiches, pizzas, entrees, and desserts. The brewery hosts private events in the Beer Hall and Investors Pub with in-house catering available. They also hold special events like Oktoberfest and language meetups in the Beer Garden.
